content.name: Super Safari Adventure
content.shortDescription: Quad bike through the Sinai dunes to the Valley of Echo, Bedouin tea in a tent and a camel ride.
content.description: After a short drive of about 20 minutes to the quad center, our guides give you a safety briefing before you ride across the dunes towards the Echo Mountains. At the Valley of Echo you can call out and hear your voice return from the rock walls. At a Bedouin tent you relax with traditional tea, then take a camel ride across the desert before riding back to the start. On the sunset departure the evening continues with a VIP Bedouin dinner and a Tanoura and fire show before the transfer back to your hotel.
includes: Stops at the Valley of Echo and a Bedouin tent
Sunset departure: VIP Bedouin dinner with Tanoura and fire show
knowBeforeYouGo: Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back or heart problems.
Children under 10 ride only as passengers with an accompanying adult.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Sunset Quad Bike
content.shortDescription: Ride a quad bike across the dunes as the desert turns gold, with the Valley of Echo, Bedouin tea and a camel ride at sunset.
content.description: A short drive takes you to the quad center, where guides brief you on safe riding. You ride through the dunes towards the Echo Mountains as the light turns golden, stop at the Valley of Echo, relax with Bedouin tea in a tent and take a camel ride at sunset before heading back to your hotel.
includes: Stops at the Valley of Echo and a Bedouin tent
knowBeforeYouGo: Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back or heart problems.
Children under 10 ride only as passengers with an accompanying adult.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Double Buggy & Camel Ride
content.shortDescription: Drive a two-seat sand buggy through the dunes, stop at the Valley of Echo and a Bedouin tent, then ride a camel.
content.description: After a short drive to the buggy center and a safety briefing, you and your partner drive a sand buggy across the dunes towards the Echo Mountains. You stop at the Valley of Echo and a Bedouin tent for tea, take a camel ride across the sand, and drive back to the start before your transfer to the hotel.
includes: Stops at the Valley of Echo and a Bedouin tent
knowBeforeYouGo: Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back or heart problems.
Children under 10 ride only as passengers with an accompanying adult.
The price is per buggy, which seats two.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Bedouin Dinner & Camel Ride
content.shortDescription: Ride a camel through the dunes at sunset, then enjoy a Bedouin barbecue dinner with fire and Tanoura shows.
content.description: A short drive of about 20 minutes brings you to a Bedouin village. You ride a camel through the dunes as the sun sets, then sit down to a barbecue dinner prepared by the Bedouins with fresh-baked bread and Bedouin tea. The evening ends with a fire show and a Tanoura performance before the transfer back to your hotel.
knowBeforeYouGo: A light jacket for the evening
Travelling as a family or group? A private tent can be arranged on request.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Dahab 5×1 / Colored Canyon
content.shortDescription: A full day from Sharm: the Colored Canyon by jeep, lunch by the sea, a coastal camel ride, snorkeling and Dahab's bazaar.
content.description: After a drive of about an hour to the Dahab area, a jeep takes you to the Colored Canyon (Salama Red Canyon), where you walk about 800 meters between sandstone walls in shades from yellow and purple to red and gold. You have lunch by the sea, ride a camel along the coast, and relax, swim and snorkel at the Three Pools. The day ends with free time in the Dahab bazaar before the drive back to Sharm.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Camel & Horse Ride
content.shortDescription: Ride a camel across the golden Sinai sands, or take the horse trail into the mountains — simple, authentic and family-friendly.
content.description: Move slowly across golden sand on a traditional camel ride and take in panoramic views of the mountains and open desert. Prefer a horse? Horse rides follow the mountain trail. Either way it is a simple, authentic way to experience the Sinai landscape and Bedouin culture, and a perfect first desert experience for families and couples.
includes: Camel ride in the desert or horse ride on the mountain trail
knowBeforeYouGo: Help is available to get on and off the camel.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Ras Mohamed & White Island Boat Trip
content.shortDescription: A full-day boat trip along the Sinai coast with two snorkeling stops in Ras Mohammed National Park and time on White Island.
content.description: The day starts with hotel pickup at around 8:00 and a transfer to the marina. You cruise along the Sinai coastline to Ras Mohammed National Park and snorkel at two different spots in its clear water, with an optional introductory dive. Lunch is served as a buffet on deck, then you relax on the soft sand of White Island before returning to the marina and your hotel.
includes: Ras Mohammed National Park entrance fees
Boat trip with two snorkeling stops
knowBeforeYouGo: Passport or ID (a copy is accepted)
Scuba diving is not suitable for children under 10 or pregnant women.
Plans may change with sea and weather conditions.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Evening Cruise
content.shortDescription: An evening on the water with dinner on board, music and a Tanoura and oriental show.
content.description: From 18:00 to 22:00 you sail off Sharm El Sheikh as the city lights come on. Dinner is served on board — seafood, meat, chicken, vegetables and fruit — followed by live entertainment with jugglers, a Tanoura dance and an oriental dance show. A romantic evening for couples and a lively one for friends. Celebrating a birthday? Tell us when you book and we will make the evening a little sweeter.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.name: Glass Bottom Boat
content.shortDescription: See the Red Sea's coral reefs and fish through a glass floor — no swimming needed and ideal for all ages.
content.description: Watch coral formations and marine life through the boat's glass-bottomed viewing area without getting wet. The boat sails close to well-known reef spots; the lower level is for viewing and the upper deck for sun and sea breeze. The cruise itself lasts about an hour, and you are returned to where you started.
knowBeforeYouGo: Passport or ID (a copy is accepted)
Not wheelchair accessible; strollers are fine and infants sit on laps.
content.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh; the exact time is confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

content.description: Explore deeper dive sites, refine your technique and enjoy the Red Sea's world-famous reefs and marine life on a multi-day course with professional instructors at one of Sharm El Sheikh's leading dive centers. Designed for certified divers who want more challenge.
includes: Professional instructor at a leading Sharm El Sheikh dive center
knowBeforeYouGo: An Open Water certification is required.
A medical declaration may be required.

content.name: Intro Diving
content.shortDescription: Try scuba diving for the first time — a supervised introductory dive among the Red Sea's corals and fish.
content.description: No licence or experience is needed. After a briefing, a professional instructor from one of Sharm El Sheikh's leading dive centers takes you on a short introductory dive to see colourful coral reefs and tropical fish in a safe, relaxed setting. Booked on request — message us on WhatsApp and we will arrange your time.
includes: Introductory dive with a professional instructor
knowBeforeYouGo: Not suitable for people with heart, ear or breathing problems.
A medical declaration may be required.
Not suitable for children under 10 or pregnant women.

content.description: Sail along the coast with three stops for snorkeling over colourful coral. The sailboat has an upper deck with seating, sun loungers, indoor lounges and swings over the sea. A seafood buffet lunch and drinks are served on board.

content.name: Ras Mohamed by Bus
content.shortDescription: A half day in Ras Mohammed National Park by road: snorkeling, mangroves, the Magic Lake and the Earth Crack.
content.description: About 30 minutes from Sharm, Ras Mohammed National Park welcomes you at the Allah Gate. You snorkel over coral in the park's clear water, walk among the mangroves, swim in the salty Magic Lake, see the Earth Crack and climb a cliff for a panoramic photo before returning to your hotel. The trip runs from about 8:00 to 14:00.
includes: Ras Mohammed National Park entrance fees
knowBeforeYouGo: Snorkeling gear, swimwear and a towel

content.name: Cairo by Bus
content.shortDescription: A long day trip by road to Cairo: the Egyptian Museum with an Egyptologist, lunch by the Nile and the Pyramids of Giza.
content.description: Travel by bus to Cairo and start at the Egyptian Museum, where an Egyptologist guides you through highlights including the treasures of Tutankhamun. After lunch at a restaurant on the Nile, you visit papyrus and perfume workshops and then the Giza Plateau with the Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure and the Great Sphinx, before the long ride back to Sharm.
includes: Entrance fees to the sites in the program
knowBeforeYouGo: Comfortable clothing, a hat and sunscreen

content.shortDescription: Fly to Cairo for the day: the Egyptian Museum, lunch by the Nile, the Pyramids and the Sphinx, then fly back.

content.name: Mount Sinai & St. Catherine
content.shortDescription: Climb Mount Sinai overnight to watch the sunrise from the summit, then visit St. Catherine's Monastery.
content.description: Pickup is around 20:00 for a drive of about 4 hours. You climb Mount Sinai (2,285 m), finishing with some 750 steps, in 2–3 hours to watch the sunrise from the top. After descending you visit St. Catherine's Monastery and the Chapel of the Burning Bush before returning to Sharm around 13:30. Camels can carry you only for the first part of the path.
knowBeforeYouGo: Hiking shoes and a warm jacket (it is cold at the top, especially in winter)
Water, snacks and a power bank
Not suitable for pregnant women, children, older guests or people with back, heart or breathing problems.
Runs on Sundays, Wednesdays and Fridays.

content.name: Luxor by Plane
content.shortDescription: Fly to Luxor for the day: the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut's temple, the Colossi of Memnon and Karnak.
content.description: An early transfer takes you to Sharm airport for the short flight to Luxor. With an Egyptologist you visit the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari and the Colossi of Memnon, have lunch at a local restaurant, and explore Karnak Temple and its Hypostyle Hall before flying back in the evening.

content.description: Visit the famous St. Catherine's Monastery with its historic church, icon gallery, the Burning Bush and library. Afterwards you have lunch at a restaurant in Dahab and free time to stroll the town before returning to Sharm. A comfortable day for history lovers and travellers seeking a spiritual experience.

content.name: Sharm Airport Transfer
content.shortDescription: Private transfer between your hotel and Sharm El Sheikh airport by car or minibus.
content.description: Our driver collects you from your hotel reception and takes you directly to Sharm El Sheikh International Airport, or meets you on arrival. Choose the vehicle that fits your group: a sedan (€15), a higher SUV (€20) or a Hiace minibus (€35) — the price is per vehicle, not per person.
knowBeforeYouGo: Please send your flight details when booking.
